SINSAL_NOTE_TPL: This trait sits in your {role} — so {theme} shows up most in that area.

BY_INTENSITY.SELF_SOURCED: Your strong 'self-sourced' energy makes this tendency especially pronounced and self-directed.
BY_INTENSITY.ENVIRONMENT_TUNED: Your 'environment-tuned' temperament means this trait emerges most deeply depending on the people and setting around you.
BY_INTENSITY.BALANCED_CORE: Your balanced 'core' energy guides this tendency in a stable and harmonious direction.

BY_ELEMENT.GROWTH: Growth (Wood) energy layers on top of this — a strong drive to keep expanding and opening new directions.
BY_ELEMENT.SPARK: Spark (Fire) energy layers on top of this — a passionate, immediate force pushing this tendency forward.
BY_ELEMENT.GROUND: Ground (Earth) energy layers on top of this — this tendency expresses through thoughtful, solid foundation-building.
BY_ELEMENT.EDGE: Edge (Metal) energy layers on top of this — you sort through this with clear standards and sharp decisiveness.
BY_ELEMENT.FLOW: Flow (Water) energy layers on top of this — this tendency gains a flexible, responsive wisdom that adapts to the moment.

love.THE_TWIN: The 'Twin' mode is especially strong — you treat your partner as a lifelong colleague and an equal, not a role to play.
love.THE_RIVAL: The 'Rival' mode is especially strong — you want a relationship where you both push each other and grow together.
love.THE_ALLY: The 'Ally' mode is especially strong — once you commit to a bond, you stay with it and give it your full loyalty.

career.THE_CREATOR: The 'Creator' mode is especially strong — you shine when you break existing molds and create original work.
career.THE_OFFICER: The 'Officer' mode is especially strong — you grow into a trusted core talent inside structured organizations.
career.THE_CHALLENGER: The 'Challenger' mode is especially strong — you have the instincts of a leader who solves problems and breaks through crises.

wealth.THE_OPERATOR: The 'Operator' mode is especially strong — you spot opportunities others miss and grow your assets decisively.
wealth.THE_STEWARD: The 'Steward' mode is especially strong — you protect what you have and let compound growth do its work.
wealth.THE_FLOW: The 'Flow' mode is especially strong — you ride the current of money with flexibility and draw wealth in naturally.
